scope: Classic Zortrax M300, existing qualified HW05/Rev.5.3/256-KiB profile. Sources, compiled firmware, three distribution routes, active host tools, documentation and publication controls.
owner_hardware_evidence: HARDWARE_STATUS.json; approximately two weeks reported for baseline 1.4, not the new 1.4.1 patch.

findings.problem: Power interruption during the 64-byte metadata header or 4-byte commit leaves NO_COMMIT. Baseline 1.4 refuses ordinary boot correctly but also prevents reinstalling the same verified APP.
findings.change: Installation-only retry accepts only an expected halfword prefix, at most one monotonically incomplete halfword and an erased remainder/tail. It additionally verifies the complete existing APP hash and vectors against the verified candidate before any erase.
findings.limits: The new BOOT must already be installed. Does not make old 1.4 already stuck in NO_COMMIT install itself, accept foreign metadata, recover incomplete APP payloads or reconstruct a mass-erased device.

findings.problem: Wrong-sized existing templates or a directory could be reported as prepared, while other files were created.
findings.change: Preflight all existing entries as nonsymlink regular files of exact required length before creating any missing template; retain valid existing bytes.

findings.problem: Serial-open failure leaked partially opened resources. A close failure could prevent final evidence from being archived.
findings.change: Clean up partially initialized resources without masking the original error, attempt all closes, preserve the manifest/archive on close error and return failure. Accept only exact current INFO/BOARD_CHECK lines.

findings.component: STLINK inner guide and publication consistency
findings.problem: The previous STLINK ZIP retained a stale internal guide despite newer external instructions.
findings.change: Package current complete EN/PL STLINK instructions with exact addresses, halt/readback procedure, first-start interruption, UART migration and explicit recovery scope. Align tools, version indexes, release notes, checksum catalogs and automated checks.

findings.finding: 1,000,000 baud was already removed in baseline 1.4. 1.4.1 retains exactly 115200, 250000, 500000, 750000 and 1500000; default 250000. 1,000,000 and 10,000,000 are rejected by active host CLIs before device/file I/O.
findings.migration: Saved baud-code holes are retained; removed settings fall back to the existing default. No automatic save or experimental Orange Pi divider override is introduced.

memory.engineering_limit: Main BOOT slot is nearly full. Future firmware changes must pass linker/layout checks and may require deliberate code-size work; no additional free space is claimed.

independent_clean_rebuild.byte_identical: FULL, READONLY, PREVIEW and installer artifacts

compiled_arm_predicate.scope: Actual compiled board predicate and linked helpers in Unicorn; no complete boot or physical Flash hardware emulation.

public_downloads.diagnostic: Existing 0.5.5 backup utility is a separate unchanged auxiliary download.

public_content: Compiled distributables, operational tools and EN/PL manuals. Private firmware sources, OEM tooling secrets, complete personal Flash backups and raw device identity remain excluded.
